source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Measure attendance at education sessions without determining whether the learner can perform the task","B":"Confirm that staff can correctly apply required knowledge and technical skills to perform assigned tasks safely","C":"Replace all education and training because competency can be assessed without foundational knowledge or skills","D":"Evaluate personality traits rather than the ability to perform role-specific clinical responsibilities safely"}}
source_row.rationale: The Joint Commission distinguishes competency from education and training: competency includes the ability to synthesize and correctly apply knowledge and technical skills. Assessment validates that the individual can perform required tasks.
source_row.source_detail: Standards FAQ: competency includes knowledge, technical skills, and ability; last updated June 24, 2026; accessed 2026-08-14.
source_row.source_name: The Joint Commission — Competency Assessment vs Education and Training
source_row.stem: What is the purpose of competency validation for clinical staff?
